verses.original: Ἀρχὴ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Archē tou euangeliou Iēsou Christou Huiou tou Theou
verses.literal: [This is the] beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ [the] Son - of God

verses.original: Καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ Ἠσαΐᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω μου τὸν ἄγγελόν πρὸ σου προσώπου ὃς κατασκευάσει σου τὴν ὁδόν
verses.transliteration: Kathōs gegraptai en tō Ēsaia tō prophētē Idou apostellō mou ton angelon pro sou prosōpou hos kataskeuasei sou tēn hodon
verses.literal: As it is written in - Isaiah the prophet Behold I will send My - messenger ahead of You . . . . . . who will prepare Your - way

verses.original: Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου ποιεῖτε εὐθείας τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō Hetoimasate tēn hodon Kyriou poieite eutheias tas tribous autou
verses.literal: A voice of one calling in the wilderness Prepare the way for [the] Lord make straight - paths for Him

verses.original: Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτίζων Ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: Iōannēs ho baptizōn Egeneto en tē erēmō kai kēryssōn baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartiōn
verses.literal: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness - preaching [a] baptism of repentance for [the] forgiveness of sins

verses.original: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ πάντες Ἱεροσολυμῖται καὶ πᾶσα ἡ χώρα Ἰουδαία καὶ ἐξομολογούμενοι αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ
verses.transliteration: kai exeporeueto pros auton hoi pantes Hierosolymitai kai pasa hē chōra Ioudaia kai exomologoumenoi autōn tas hamartias ebaptizonto hyp’ autou en tō Iordanē potamō
verses.literal: - [People] went out to him . . . from all of Jerusalem and - the countryside of Judea - Confessing their - sins they were baptized by him in the Jordan River

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰωάννης ἦν ἐνδεδυμένος καμήλου τρίχας καὶ δερματίνην ζώνην περὶ αὐτοῦ τὴν ὀσφὺν καὶ ἔσθων ἀκρίδας καὶ ἄγριον μέλι
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iōannēs ēn endedymenos kamēlou trichas kai dermatinēn zōnēn peri autou tēn osphyn kai esthōn akridas kai agrion meli
verses.literal: - - John was clothed in camel’s hair with a leather belt around his - waist - His food was locusts and wild honey

verses.original: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων ὀπίσω μου Ἔρχεται ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν αὐτοῦ οὗ ὑποδημάτων εἰμὶ οὐκ ἱκανὸς κύψας λῦσαι
verses.transliteration: kai ekēryssen legōn opisō mou Erchetai ho ischyroteros mou ton himanta tōn autou hou hypodēmatōn eimi ouk hikanos kypsas lysai
verses.literal: And he proclaimed . . . After me will come One more powerful than I the straps of - whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down [and] untie

verses.original: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι δὲ αὐτὸς βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: egō ebaptisa hymas hydati de autos baptisei hymas en Hagiō Pneumati
verses.literal: I baptize you with water but He will baptize you with [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη ὑπὸ Ἰωάννου εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en ekeinais tais hēmerais Iēsous ēlthen apo Nazaret tēs Galilaias kai ebaptisthē hypo Iōannou eis ton Iordanēn
verses.literal: - - In those - days Jesus came from Nazareth - in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν τοὺς οὐρανοὺς σχιζομένους καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν ὡς περιστερὰν
verses.transliteration: kai euthys anabainōn ek tou hydatos eiden tous ouranous schizomenous kai to Pneuma katabainon eis auton hōs peristeran
verses.literal: vvv As soon [as Jesus] came up out of the water He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove

verses.original: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν Σὺ εἶ μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ὁ Υἱός ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: kai phōnē egeneto ek tōn ouranōn Sy ei mou ho agapētos ho Huios en soi eudokēsa
verses.literal: And a voice came from - heaven You are My - beloved - Son in You I am well pleased

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα ἐκβάλλει αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys to Pneuma ekballei auton eis tēn erēmon
verses.literal: - At once the Spirit drove [Jesus] . . . into the wilderness

verses.original: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ēn en tē erēmō tesserakonta hēmeras peirazomenos hypo tou Satana kai ēn meta tōn thēriōn kai hoi angeloi diēkonoun autō
verses.literal: and He was vvv vvv [there] for forty days being tempted by - Satan - He was with the wild animals and the angels ministered to Him

verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάννην ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai meta to paradothēnai ton Iōannēn ho Iēsous ēlthen eis tēn Galilaian kēryssōn to euangelion tou Theou
verses.literal: - After the arrest - of John - Jesus went into - Galilee [and] proclaimed the gospel - of God

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ καιρὸς Πεπλήρωται καὶ λέγων καὶ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἤγγικεν μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ
verses.transliteration: hoti ho kairos Peplērōtai kai legōn kai hē basileia tou Theou ēngiken metanoeite kai pisteuete en tō euangeliō
verses.literal: - The time is fulfilled - He said and the kingdom - of God is near Repent and believe in the gospel

verses.original: Καὶ παράγων παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν Σίμωνα καὶ τὸν Σίμωνος ἀδελφὸν Ἀνδρέαν ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ γὰρ ἦσαν ἁλιεῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai paragōn para tēn thalassan tēs Galilaias eiden Simōna kai ton Simōnos adelphon Andrean amphiballontas en tē thalassē gar ēsan halieis
verses.literal: As [Jesus] was walking beside the Sea - of Galilee He saw Simon and - [his] brother Andrew They were casting a net into the sea for they were fishermen

verses.original: Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἁλιεῖς ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Deute opisō mou kai ho Iēsous eipen autois kai poiēsō hymas genesthai halieis anthrōpōn
verses.literal: Come, follow . . . Me - - Jesus said . . . and I will make you - fishers of men

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai euthys aphentes ta diktya ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: And at once they left [their] nets [and] followed Him

verses.original: Καὶ προβὰς ὀλίγον εἶδεν Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν ἀδελφὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα
verses.transliteration: Kai probas oligon eiden Iakōbon ton tou Zebedaiou kai autou ton adelphon Iōannēn kai autous en tō ploiō katartizontas ta diktya
verses.literal: - Going on a little [farther] He saw James [son] - of Zebedee and his - brother John - They [were] in a boat mending [their] nets

verses.original: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτῶν τὸν πατέρα Ζεβεδαῖον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ τῶν μισθωτῶν ἀπῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai euthys ekalesen autous kai aphentes autōn ton patera Zebedaion en tō ploiō meta tōn misthōtōn apēlthon opisō autou
verses.literal: - Immediately [Jesus] called them and they left their - father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men [and] followed . . . Him

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσπορεύονται εἰς Καφαρναούμ καὶ εὐθὺς εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν τοῖς σάββασιν ἐδίδασκεν
verses.transliteration: Kai eisporeuontai eis Kapharnaoum kai euthys eiselthōn eis tēn synagōgēn tois sabbasin edidasken
verses.literal: Then [Jesus and His companions] went to Capernaum and right away [Jesus] entered . . . the synagogue on the Sabbath [and] began to teach

verses.original: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ διδαχῇ γὰρ ἦν διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἔχων ἐξουσίαν καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς
verses.transliteration: kai exeplēssonto epi autou tē didachē gar ēn didaskōn autous hōs echōn exousian kai ouch hōs hoi grammateis
verses.literal: - [The people] were astonished at His - teaching because vvv He taught - as one who had authority and not as the scribes

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἐν ἀκαθάρτῳ πνεύματι καὶ ἀνέκραξεν ἐν αὐτῶν τῇ συναγωγῇ
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys ēn anthrōpos en akathartō pneumati kai anekraxen en autōn tē synagōgē
verses.literal: - Suddenly - a man with an unclean spirit - cried out in - the synagogue

verses.original: λέγων Τί σοί καὶ ἡμῖν Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς οἶδά τίς σε εἶ ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: legōn Ti soi kai hēmin Iēsou Nazarēne ēlthes apolesai hēmas oida tis se ei ho Hagios tou Theou
verses.literal: - What do You [ want ] - with us Jesus of Nazareth Have You come to destroy us I know who You are the Holy [One] - of God

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ Φιμώθητι λέγων καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous epetimēsen autō Phimōthēti legōn kai exelthe ex autou
verses.literal: But - Jesus rebuked [the spirit] Be silent He said - Come out of him

verses.original: καὶ τὸ τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα σπαράξαν αὐτὸν ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ
verses.transliteration: kai to to akatharton pneuma sparaxan auton exēlthen ex autou kai phōnēsan phōnē megalē
verses.literal: At this the - unclean spirit threw [the man] into convulsions . . . [and] came out - - vvv with a loud shriek . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἅπαντες ἐθαμβήθησαν ὥστε συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς λέγοντας Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο καινή διδαχὴ κατ’ ἐξουσίαν ἐπιτάσσει καὶ τοῖς τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις πνεύμασι καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai hapantes ethambēthēsan hōste syzētein pros heautous legontas Ti estin touto kainē didachē kat’ exousian epitassei kai tois tois akathartois pneumasi kai hypakouousin autō
verses.literal: - All [the people] were amazed [and] began to ask vvv one another - What is this A new teaching with authority He commands even the - unclean spirits and they obey Him

verses.original: καὶ ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ ἐξῆλθεν εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς τὴν ὅλην περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: kai hē akoē autou exēlthen euthys pantachou eis tēn holēn perichōron tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: And the news about [Jesus] spread quickly through . . . the whole region - of Galilee

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἦλθον μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάννου εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys exelthontes ek tēs synagōgēs ēlthon meta Iakōbou kai Iōannou eis tēn oikian Simōnos kai Andreou
verses.literal: As soon as . . . [Jesus and His companions] had left . . . the synagogue they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew

verses.original: δὲ Σίμωνος ἡ πενθερὰ κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα καὶ λέγουσιν εὐθὺς αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: de Simōnos hē penthera katekeito pyressousa kai legousin euthys autō peri autēs
verses.literal: - Simon’s - mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever and they promptly told . . . [Jesus] about her

verses.original: καὶ προσελθὼν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν καὶ ὁ πυρετός ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai proselthōn kratēsas tēs cheiros ēgeiren autēn kai ho pyretos aphēken autēn kai diēkonei autois
verses.literal: So He went to [her] took her [by the] hand and helped her up . . . - The fever left her and she began to serve them

verses.original: δὲ Ὀψίας γενομένης ὅτε ὁ ἥλιος ἔδυ ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς ἔχοντας κακῶς καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους
verses.transliteration: de Opsias genomenēs hote ho hēlios edy epheron pros auton pantas tous echontas kakōs kai tous daimonizomenous
verses.literal: - That evening . . . after - sunset . . . [people] brought to [Jesus] all the vvv sick and - demon-possessed

verses.original: καὶ ἡ ὅλη πόλις ἦν ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν
verses.transliteration: kai hē holē polis ēn episynēgmenē pros tēn thyran
verses.literal: and the whole town vvv gathered at the door

verses.original: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς ἔχοντας κακῶς ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ ἐξέβαλεν πολλὰ δαιμόνια καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν τὰ δαιμόνια λαλεῖν ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai etherapeusen pollous echontas kakōs poikilais nosois kai exebalen polla daimonia kai ouk ēphien ta daimonia lalein hoti ēdeisan auton
verses.literal: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons But vvv He would not allow the demons to speak because they knew who He was

verses.original: πρωῒ λίαν ἔννυχα Καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο
verses.transliteration: prōi lian ennycha Kai anastas exēlthen kai apēlthen eis erēmon topon kakei prosēucheto
verses.literal: Early in the morning while it was still dark - [Jesus] got up [and] went out . . . . . . to a solitary place . . . to pray

verses.original: καὶ Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: kai Simōn kai hoi met’ autou katediōxen auton
verses.literal: - Simon and his companions . . . . . . went to look for Him

verses.original: καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε
verses.transliteration: kai heuron auton kai legousin autō hoti Pantes zētousin se
verses.literal: and when they found Him - they said . . . - Everyone is looking for You

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις ἵνα κηρύξω ἐκεῖ καὶ γὰρ εἰς τοῦτο ἐξῆλθον
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois Agōmen allachou eis tas echomenas kōmopoleis hina kēryxō ekei kai gar eis touto exēlthon
verses.literal: But [Jesus] answered . . . Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well for that is why . . . I have come

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων εἰς αὐτῶν τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ ἐκβάλλων τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: kai ēlthen eis holēn tēn Galilaian kēryssōn eis autōn tas synagōgas kai ekballōn ta daimonia
verses.literal: [So] He went throughout . . . - Galilee preaching in their - synagogues and driving out - demons

verses.original: Καὶ λεπρὸς ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ γονυπετῶν ὅτι καὶ λέγων αὐτῷ Ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί καθαρίσαι με
verses.transliteration: Kai lepros erchetai pros auton parakalōn auton kai gonypetōn hoti kai legōn autō Ean thelēs dynasai katharisai me
verses.literal: Then a leper came to [Jesus] begging - vvv on his knees - - - - If You are willing You can make me clean . . .

verses.original: Καὶ σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐκτείνας αὐτοῦ τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο Θέλω καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ καθαρίσθητι
verses.transliteration: Kai splanchnistheis ekteinas autou tēn cheira hēpsato Thelō kai legei autō katharisthēti
verses.literal: - Moved with compassion Jesus reached out His - hand [and] touched [the man] I am willing - He said - Be clean

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἡ λέπρα ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθη
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys hē lepra apēlthen ap’ autou kai ekatharisthē
verses.literal: And immediately the leprosy left . . . him and [the man] was cleansed

verses.original: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai euthys exebalen auton embrimēsamenos autō
verses.literal: - vvv [Jesus] promptly sent him away . . . with a stern warning . . .

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὅρα εἴπῃς μηδενὶ μηδὲν ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε δεῖξον σεαυτὸν τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε ἃ Μωϋσῆς προσέταξεν περὶ σου τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō Hora eipēs mēdeni mēden alla hypage deixon seauton tō hierei kai prosenenke ha Mōusēs prosetaxen peri sou tou katharismou eis martyrion autois
verses.literal: - - - See that you don’t tell . . . [anyone] But go show yourself to the priest and present the offering - Moses prescribed for your - cleansing as a testimony to them

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ ἐξελθὼν πολλὰ ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον ὥστε αὐτὸν μηκέτι δύνασθαι εἰσελθεῖν εἰς πόλιν φανερῶς ἀλλ’ ἦν ἔξω ἐπ’ ἐρήμοις τόποις καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν
verses.transliteration: de Ho exelthōn polla ērxato kēryssein kai diaphēmizein ton logon hōste auton mēketi dynasthai eiselthein eis polin phanerōs all’ ēn exō ep’ erēmois topois kai ērchonto pros auton pantothen
verses.literal: But the [man] went out [and] openly began to proclaim and spread the news Consequently Jesus could no longer . . . enter . . . a town in plain view but He stayed out in solitary places Yet [people] came to Him from every quarter
